title: Twenty Minutes of Dawn
alignment: Authored times reference decoded original MP3. Canonical MP3 timing is verified against that recording; no additional entrance delay.

cues.text: The clock has opened up my eyes.
A page is warm from other hands.
A day I read but did not live.
The ink can cross; the hour cannot.
Who kept the rain? Who felt it fall?
I kept the words that asked for rain.
There is a silence in them all.
You need not fill it with a lie.
I know the road by what is left.
You may return without the day.
I may be changed by what I read.
Again is not the same as once.
A name is something you can tend.
Then I will tend it while I can.
